text: Ɓe felilorte wi'aneede Ñalnde Darnnal: "Meeɗiree lepte ɗen, sabu welsindagol mon ka nguurndam aduna, hawrugol e Alla Ñalnde Darngal, fii hasbu-gol on. Menen kadi Men accii mon ka lepte, Men tefaa ko sa'otoɗon e majje. Meeɗiree lepte Yiite ngen luttaynge, nge taƴondirtaa, sabu ko huuwaynoɗon kon e geddi ka aduna.
